facts.fact: Kayla 一周后仍愤怒，但拒绝再买「事后漂亮话」的账
facts.anchor: A man can say the right thing after he fucked up, but I know better than to buy into it

facts.fact: Vero 赔偿 Rogue 酒吧损失，把整间酒吧堆满花，署名「我们所有人」
facts.anchor: The entire bar is filled with flowers, not just a few bunches, but every single surface is covered

facts.fact: Kayla 开卡车把花全部运回岛上，一根根扔向四人
facts.anchor: I build up a satisfying rhythm, picking them up and throwing them

facts.fact: Kayla 点名 Vero：毁掉一整个酒吧，别以为花能修好
facts.anchor: And fuck you for beating up an entire bar and thinking flowers would fix that

facts.fact: Kayla 拒绝接受 sorry 一词：真后悔就不会先做
facts.anchor: “Don’t you dare say sorry, it’s just a word. If you were so sorry, you never would have done it in the first place.”

facts.fact: Cave 的谜语：我是留下、是陪你坐在地上起不来的那个，比爱更罕见
facts.anchor: I am what stays. I am what sits on the floor with you when you cannot get up

facts.fact: Kayla 不假思索答「朋友」，Cave 说没人答对过，赐她保护
facts.anchor: “A friend,” I say without overthinking my answer

facts.fact: 墓园里 Clay 截住 Kayla，她宣告要让追捕变难，身体却背叛了意志
